shortDescription: NetApp Cloud Manager CVO for AWS

options.name: aws_tag
options.description: Additional tags for the AWS CVO working environment.

options.name: backup_volumes_to_cbs
options.description: Automatically enable back up of all volumes to S3.

options.name: capacity_package_name
options.description: Capacity package name is required when selecting a capacity based license. Essential only available with Bring Your Own License Capacity-Based. Professional available as an annual contract from AWS marketplace or Bring Your Own License Capacity-Based.

options.name: capacity_tier
options.description: Whether to enable data tiering for the first data aggregate.

options.name: client_id
options.description: The connector ID of the Cloud Manager Connector. You can find the ID from the Connector tab on U(https://cloudmanager.netapp.com).

options.name: cloud_provider_account
options.description: The cloud provider credentials id to use when deploying the Cloud Volumes ONTAP system. You can find the ID in Cloud Manager from the Settings > Credentials page. If not specified, Cloud Manager uses the instance profile of the Connector.

options.name: cluster_floating_ip
options.description: For HA FloatingIP, the cluster management floating IP address.

options.name: cluster_key_pair_name
options.description: SSH authentication key pair name

options.name: data_encryption_type
options.description: The type of encryption to use for the working environment.

options.name: data_floating_ip
options.description: For HA FloatingIP, the data floating IP address.

options.name: data_floating_ip2
options.description: For HA FloatingIP, the data floating IP address.

options.name: ebs_volume_size
options.description: EBS volume size for the first data aggregate. For GB, the value can be [100 or 500]. For TB, the value can be [1,2,4,8,16].

options.name: ebs_volume_size_unit
options.description: The unit for ebs volume size.

options.name: ebs_volume_type
options.description: The EBS volume type for the first data aggregate.

options.name: enable_compliance
options.description: Enable the Cloud Compliance service on the working environment.

options.name: enable_monitoring
options.description: Enable the Monitoring service on the working environment.

options.name: environment
options.description: The environment for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: failover_mode
options.description: For HA, the failover mode for the HA pair. 'PrivateIP' is for a single availability zone and 'FloatingIP' is for multiple availability zones.

options.name: feature_flags
options.description: Enable or disable a new feature. This can be used to enable an experimental feature or disable a new feature that breaks backward compatibility. Supported keys and values are subject to change without notice.  Unknown keys are ignored.

options.name: instance_profile_name
options.description: The instance profile name for the working environment. If not provided, Cloud Manager creates the instance profile.

options.name: instance_tenancy
options.description: The EC2 instance tenancy.

options.name: instance_type
options.description: The instance type to use, which depends on the license type. Explore ['m5.xlarge']. Standard ['m5.2xlarge','r5.xlarge']. Premium ['m5.4xlarge','r5.2xlarge','c4.8xlarge']. For more supported instance types, refer to Cloud Volumes ONTAP Release Notes.

options.name: iops
options.description: Provisioned IOPS. Required only when provider_volume_type is 'io1' or 'gp3'.

options.name: is_ha
options.description: Indicate whether the working environment is an HA pair or not.

options.name: kms_key_arn
options.description: AWS encryption parameters. It is required if using aws encryption. Only one of KMS key id or KMS arn should be specified.

options.name: kms_key_id
options.description: Aws Encryption parameters. It is required if using aws encryption. Only one of KMS key id or KMS arn should be specified.

options.name: license_type
options.description: The type of license to use. For single node by Capacity ['capacity-paygo'] For single node by Node paygo ['cot-explore-paygo', 'cot-standard-paygo', 'cot-premium-paygo']. For single node by Node boyl ['cot-premium-byol']. For HA by Capacity ['ha-capacity-paygo'] For HA by Node paygo ['ha-cot-explore-paygo','ha-cot-standard-paygo','ha-cot-premium-paygo']. For HA by Node boyl ['ha-cot-premium-byol'].

options.name: mediator_assign_public_ip
options.description: Boolean option to assign public IP.

options.name: mediator_key_pair_name
options.description: For HA, the key pair name for the mediator instance.

options.name: mediator_subnet_id
options.description: For HA, the subnet ID of the mediator.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the Cloud Manager CVO for AWS to manage.

options.name: node1_subnet_id
options.description: For HA, the subnet ID of the first node.

options.name: node2_subnet_id
options.description: For HA, the subnet ID of the second node.

options.name: nss_account
options.description: The NetApp Support Site account ID to use with this Cloud Volumes ONTAP system. If the license type is BYOL and an NSS account is not provided, Cloud Manager tries to use the first existing NSS account.

options.name: ontap_version
options.description: The required ONTAP version. Ignored if 'use_latest_version' is set to true.

options.name: optimized_network_utilization
options.description: Use optimized network utilization.

options.name: platform_serial_number
options.description: The serial number for the cluster. This is required when using 'cot-premium-byol'.

options.name: platform_serial_number_node1
options.description: For HA BYOL, the serial number for the first node. This is required when using 'ha-cot-premium-byol'.

options.name: platform_serial_number_node2
options.description: For HA BYOL, the serial number for the second node. This is required when using 'ha-cot-premium-byol'.

options.name: provided_license
options.description: Using a NLF license file for BYOL deployment.

options.name: refresh_token
options.description: The refresh token for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: region
options.description: The region where the working environment will be created.

options.name: route_table_ids
options.description: For HA FloatingIP, the list of route table IDs that will be updated with the floating IPs.

options.name: sa_client_id
options.description: The service account secret client ID for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: sa_secret_key
options.description: The service account secret key for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: security_group_id
options.description: The ID of the security group for the working environment. If not provided, Cloud Manager creates the security group.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the specified Cloud Manager CVO for AWS should exist or not.

options.name: subnet_id
options.description: The subnet id where the working environment will be created. Required when single node only.

options.name: svm_floating_ip
options.description: For HA FloatingIP, the SVM management floating IP address.

options.name: svm_name
options.description: The name of the SVM.

options.name: svm_password
options.description: The admin password for Cloud Volumes ONTAP. It will be updated on each run.

options.name: throughput
options.description: Unit is Mb/s. Valid range 125-1000. Required only when provider_volume_type is 'gp3'.

options.name: tier_level
options.description: The tiering level when 'capacity_tier' is set to 'S3'.

options.name: update_svm_password
options.description: Indicates whether to update svm_password on the CVO. When set to true, the module is not idempotent, as we cannot read the current password.

options.name: upgrade_ontap_version
options.description: Indicates whether to upgrade ONTAP image on the CVO. If the current version already matches the desired version, no action is taken.

options.name: use_latest_version
options.description: Indicates whether to use the latest available ONTAP version.

options.name: vpc_id
options.description: The VPC ID where the working environment will be created. If this argument is not provided, the VPC will be calculated by using the provided subnet ID.

options.name: workspace_id
options.description: The ID of the Cloud Manager workspace where you want to deploy Cloud Volumes ONTAP. If not provided, Cloud Manager uses the first workspace. You can find the ID from the Workspace tab on U(https://cloudmanager.netapp.com).

options.name: writing_speed_state
options.description: The write speed setting for Cloud Volumes ONTAP ['NORMAL','HIGH']. This argument is not relevant for HA pairs.
